title: ApplePie's Arsenals
description: This mod is a half fanmade version of the content smp mods
body:
Weapon Abilities and Combat Functions
### The AMPE
This weapon functions as a high-impact displacement tool. Upon striking a target, it triggers an intense vertical kinetic launch, driving the enemy straight up into the air.

### The Condensed Energy Rapier
Built entirely around high mobility and speed, this weapon grants the user a rapid dash ability. When activated, it propels you forward instantly, allowing you to close the gap on targets, dodge incoming attacks, or chain quick strikes together. The velocity of the dash makes it the ultimate tool for aggressive pacing and outmaneuvering opponents.

### The Scythe
Instead of knocking enemies away, the blade does the exact opposite—the moment it connects with a target, it exerts a pulling force that drags the enemy directly into melee range. It is perfect for trapping fast-moving targets or reeling in annoying ranged mobs.

### The Blast Thrower
A heavy suppression weapon built for area denial. It allows you to hurl explosive fireballs at a distance, dealing splash damage to groups of enemies.

## And even more.
